Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Scrooge
Punchline: A gil saved is a gil earned.
Description: "You might say that everythin's for sale here in Ul'dah — as long as you've got the gil." — Momodi Modi
Changelog: The v3 era. Prices now come from what actually sells: your own sale history builds a lane per item, listings are judged as crashers, competition, or dreamers, and every price speaks its evidence. The Round runs the whole errand from one button - price check, recon, your triage calls, melting, listing, GC turn-in - with a live deck, chaptered transcripts, and a Board Mirror showing the exact rows a verdict was reached on. Triage cases lay out the whole argument and take your ruling (including hold - do nothing, ask me again). Venture Coffers open before melting; a held ask that reads as a lone lowball under the real market gets flagged instead of silently kept; Ban and Always Vendor are one right-click in your bags, no window needed. The settings window was rebuilt tab by tab so every knob says what it truly does, in plain language, with the details on hover. Universalis fills the gaps when your own history is silent - your world's sale pace, your data center's sales - and your own evidence always outranks it.
